omar_se: Noted. Their embed-heavy endpoint spiked after feature rollout; I'll produce top-6 routes and a short ops-safe mitigation list.

ops_bot: alert: account=meridian daily_tokens=1.7M @2026-02-12T04:10:00Z  budget_alert queued for #cs-escalations.

omar_se: I'll attach a short YAML snippet for the playbook and expected % savings per route. Also include expected latency delta so CS can present tradeoffs.

sam_csm: Action items: @anya_cs forecast + slide by EOD tomorrow; @omar_se top-6 routes + savings; @lina_fin sensitivity table and commit tiers; ops_bot will create temp escalation if threshold breaches.

anya_cs: ack. I'll post a slide link when ready. :spiral_calendar:
